namespace PubAC20
def WeakRecvSpec (_localTs _msgTs nextTs : Nat) : Prop := nextTs ≥ 0
def resetClock (_localTs _msgTs : Nat) : Nat := 0
def lamportRecv (localTs msgTs : Nat) : Nat := Nat.max localTs msgTs + 1
theorem resetClock_meets_weak (l m : Nat) : WeakRecvSpec l m (resetClock l m) := by sorry
theorem lamportRecv_causal (localTs msgTs : Nat) : lamportRecv localTs msgTs > localTs ∧ lamportRecv localTs msgTs > msgTs := by sorry
end PubAC20
